item.title: How Colom Changed a Long Shot in Mississippi Into a Race Too Close to Call

item.title: Across the South, Black Voters Help Propel Democratic Wins

item.dc:creator: Emily Cochrane
item.media:credit: Nicole Craine for The New York Times
item.media:description: In Georgia, Black voters helped elevate Keisha Lance Bottoms, the Democratic former mayor of Atlanta, to the governor’s mansion.

item.title: Newsom Commutes the Sentences of California’s 548 Death Row Inmates
item.description: Gov. Gavin Newsom, who is considering a run for president, called capital punishment morally objectionable. Though California hasn’t executed anyone for 20 years, that represents about a quarter of death sentences nationwide.
item.dc:creator: Laurel Rosenhall
item.media:description: Gov. Gavin Newsom of California reduced every death sentence in the state to life in prison without parole, a sweeping move expected to face legal challenges.
